newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: New Madagascar president names prime minister.
newsitem.headline: New Madagascar president names prime minister.

text.p: Didier Ratsiraka, the new president of Madagascar, named his old friend, businessman and former finance minister Pascal Rakotomavo as prime minister on Friday.
Ratsiraka, military ruler of Madagascar for 16 years until 1993, said he chose Rakotomavo, 62, because of his technical expertise and because he had been a good friend for the past 45 years.
Under the constitution, the president must choose one of 14 names proposed by parliamentarians in the national assembly.
The former admiral was proclaimed president on January 31 after an election victory over Albert Zafy, the outgoing president who in 1993 defeated Ratsiraka at the polls ending his military rule.
In his bid to oust Zafy, Ratsiraka, 60, campaigned on promises of establishing a "humanistic and ecological" republic in Madagascar, whose 14 million people live in chronic poverty.
